claims.claim_text: If a fan alarm comes and goes on one fan tray and the fan sounds normal, take the tray out, blow out the dust and reseat it. It's usually dust on the connector rather than a dead fan.
claims.symptom: intermittent fan alarm on one fan tray, fan sounds normal
claims.check_step: check whether the alarm is on a particular tray
claims.action: take the tray out, blow out the dust and reseat it
